description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_Response_Stream, a subclass of Zend_Http_Response, which manages HTTP responses with stream handling capabilities, including reading from streams, managing stream resources, and constructing response objects from stream data.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Response_Stream
classes.description: A class extending Zend_Http_Response to handle HTTP responses with stream resources, including methods for managing streams, cleanup, and constructing from stream data.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the stream resource associated with the response.

methods.name: setStream
methods.description: Sets the stream resource for the response.

methods.name: getCleanup
methods.description: Returns whether the stream file should be cleaned up when the response is closed.

methods.name: setCleanup
methods.description: Sets the cleanup flag for the stream file.

methods.name: getStreamName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the stream.

methods.name: setStreamName
methods.description: Sets the filename associated with the stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the response, handling stream resource initialization.

methods.name: fromStream
methods.description: Creates a response object from a response string and stream resource.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the response body, reading from the stream if necessary.

methods.name: getRawBody
methods.description: Returns the raw response body as transferred on the wire.

methods.name: readStream
methods.description: Reads the content from the stream resource into the body.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that closes the stream resource and deletes the stream file if cleanup is enabled.
